measurement_notes: Frozen inputs reconstructed using earlier recorded tool decisions/query vectors and local source data; not original captured wire payloads.
Input body SHA256 is identical across all ten repetitions within each question.
Native app tool_choice=auto is retained; a tool-call response is reported separately and is not a completed Persian answer.
Timing excludes retrieval, embedding, verification, app queue, Redis and browser painting.
TCP connect includes DNS and the local route; server-side queue/inference/gateway forwarding cannot be split.
The stream stops at [DONE], matching the application; a receive_response_body.failed trace at intentional early close is not a provider error.
Repeated inputs may benefit from upstream prompt caching; reported cached tokens are retained per request.
No p95 claim is made from only ten trials per question.
